public_health_question.v: What are the extent, clinical features, exposures and vectors of the 2000 Rift Valley fever outbreak in Saudi Arabia?

ev.q: This report updates the findings of the ongoing investigation conducted by the Saudi Arabian MOH in collaboration with CDC
Update: Outbreak of Rift Valley Fever --- Saudi Arabia, August--November 2000
This report updates the findings of the ongoing investigation
Suspected cases have been identified through an elaborate pre-existing system of primary health-care centers
A regional survey for RVF antibody prevalence in domestic ungulates, primarily goats and sheep, was conducted

equity.level_reason: Citizenship of cases (nativity) appears only as a descriptor; age and sex are descriptors too. No group results or equity framing.

level_alternative.reason: Nationality in an international outbreak report may be read as a case characteristic rather than a social-position descriptor.

ev.q: the median age was 46 years (range: 1--95 years)
424 (82%) were Saudi citizens, 80 (16%) were Yemeni citizens, and 12 (2%) were of other nationalities

notes: Case counts by citizenship and province are distributions of cases, not compared outcomes. The animal antibody survey and the human-case/irrigation-area 'correlation' are descriptive; no test or measure is given.
